findings.finding: The base case has two different returns on capital. drivers.terminal.roic base = 0.31 drives the DCF fair value of 367$. company_path.scenarios.base.roic = 0.20 drives the annual-table multiple. Both are labelled own_history, and the terminal.roic reason claims 'one story per scenario with company_path'. Its own cited history says incremental ROIC was about 21.8% in FY2023-25 and 13-15% on the 2026 additions. So the 0.31 terminal value is the average return on all capital, applied to the new capital.
findings.where: evidence_pack.json drivers['terminal.roic'] (base 0.31, bull 0.34) vs inputs.json company_path.scenarios.base.roic 0.20 / bull 0.29
findings.fix: Make one base return on capital and use it in both places (or write explicitly why the terminal return on all capital differs from the return on new capital in the multiple), and rerun ticker-value; the reviewer of numbers should check the fair value sensitivity to terminal.roic 0.20 vs 0.31.

findings.finding: Non-marketable securities are added to the value per share at full carrying value with investment_haircut 0. The opening long_term_investments of 131,461m (2026-06-30; 135,230m at 2026-09-30) is about 10.7$ a share, roughly 3% of the 367$ fair value. These are private-company stakes carried at observable-transaction marks: 2026 year-to-date unrealized gains are about 126.8bn, and Q3 alone had an 8.7bn loss. Their basis is not cash-like, and the pack holds no note that tests liquidity or mark quality.
findings.fix: Show the non-marketable stakes as a separate line (not spendable cash) with a stated haircut or a range, and source the basis from the 10-Q equity-securities note (measurement alternative / observable price changes); rerun.

findings.finding: Syndicated or third-party copies do not name their original. ex_call_q3_2026 (an Investing.com copy of Alphabet's own call), dc_call_20260722 (the Alpha Vantage transcript of the Q2 call) and mc_reuters_adtech_20260917 (thestar.com.my reprint of Reuters) are all independent=false but syndicated_from=null. ticker-trace therefore reports syndicated = {} and nothing ties these copies to their originals.
findings.fix: Set syndicated_from to the original (issuer Q3 2026 earnings webcast 2026-10-28; issuer Q2 2026 webcast 2026-07-22; Reuters 2026-09-17).
